references.text: The description of the daily burnt offering (tamid) that was to be offered morning and evening, which is the basis for the 'morning burnt offering' mentioned in Numbers 28:23
The complete regulation for the daily burnt offering (olat ha-tamid) to which the Passover sacrifice is added
The same principle that the Sabbath offering is added to the daily burnt offering
The same wording is used for the new moon offering, which is added to the daily burnt offering
The same principle is repeated for the offering on the first day of the seventh month
The same wording is used for the Day of Atonement offering in addition to the daily burnt offering
Ezekiel's vision of the daily morning burnt offering in the rebuilt temple
